PURPOSE
The purpose of this policy is to ensure that cardiac MRI procedures are medically necessary and appropriate for the patient's condition. This policy applies to all network and out of network providers.
label: NOT_REQUIRED_DOC_SECTION

input:
INTRODUCTION
United Healthcare requires prior authorization for select advanced imaging services. This policy establishes the criteria for approval of cardiac magnetic resonance imaging procedures.
label: NOT_REQUIRED_DOC_SECTION

input:
Policy Statement
Aetna covers cardiac MRI when it is determined to be medically necessary based on established clinical criteria. This policy does not apply to Medicare or Medicaid plans.
label: NOT_REQUIRED_DOC_SECTION

input:
CLINICAL CRITERIA
For cardiac MRI to be approved the following clinical criteria must be met:
• LVEF must be documented and below normal range
• Symptoms must be present for minimum 3 months
• Prior echocardiogram must be within 12 months
• Ordering physician must be board certified cardiologist
label: NOT_REQUIRED_DOC_SECTION

input:
Medical Necessity Criteria
Cardiac MRI is considered medically necessary when all of the following are met:
1. Patient has documented cardiac diagnosis
2. LVEF is documented and below 55 percent
3. Prior echocardiogram results are inconclusive
4. Ordering physician is a qualified cardiologist
label: NOT_REQUIRED_DOC_SECTION

input:
COVERAGE CRITERIA
The following criteria must be satisfied for approval:
• Confirmed diagnosis of cardiomyopathy or heart failure
• LVEF documented below 40 percent
• Failed minimum 6 weeks of medical management
• Specialist evaluation completed
label: NOT_REQUIRED_DOC_SECTION

input:
Clinical Indications
Cardiac MRI is indicated for patients with:
- Documented cardiomyopathy with reduced ejection fraction
- Inconclusive echocardiogram results
- Suspected cardiac sarcoidosis or myocarditis
- Pre-operative cardiac assessment
label: NOT_REQUIRED_DOC_SECTION

input:
